references.context: Use the ACME Crate for episodes, Anvil awards, items, and the Super Jackpot.
references.label: ACME Crate
references.description: Center shot used by episode starts, item awards, and several multiball collects.

references.context: Use the ACME Vault to start episodes and collect Encore.
references.label: ACME Vault
references.description: Upper-flipper target bank and episode or Encore collect.

references.context: Hit the captive ball for Giant Rocket Multiball and Taz-Mania.
references.label: Rocket captive ball
references.description: Central captive-ball assembly used for fuse progress and rocket Super Jackpots.

references.label: Left ramp
references.description: The left ramp advances Anvil qualification and starts Marvin modes when lit.
references.context: Shoot the left ramp before the Crate for Anvil progress.

references.label: Right orbit lock
references.description: The right orbit collects qualified Rocket locks.
references.context: Collect three Rocket locks at the right orbit.

references.label: Blueprint lane
references.description: The hidden upper-left lane builds the timed playfield multiplier.
references.context: Use the upper-left lane to build Blueprint playfield X.

references.label: TNT lane
references.description: The lane below the upper-right flipper starts TNT Add-A-Ball when qualified.
references.context: Shoot the TNT lane below the upper-right flipper.
